title: Require Closed Service Source And Proof Topology
forbids: false package admission, open project or source interiors, loose service modules, unclassified model cabinets, source-owned proof, and generic proof drawers
why: A service has one public client, one private implementation spine, sealed modules, and disjoint contract, semantics, and execution proof. Habitat closes the geometry without selecting vendor syntax.
remediate: Keep only the closed service project, client, private spine, module, model, middleware, and proof members described by the local compatibility law. Move every loose file to its qualified owner or delete it.
message: Services require the closed vendor-neutral source and proof topology.
